class.name: CgameTransactionCoordinator
class.brief_description: Two-phase-commit coordinator with a durable decision log and a persistent order book.
class.description: [CgameTransactionCoordinator] drives atomic multi-participant transactions with presumed abort. [method begin] logs the intent and the per-participant operations, [method run] asks every participant to prepare and then logs a single durable COMMIT or ABORT decision before delivering it. Per-participant acknowledgements are logged too, so a restart never re-sends a finished commit. Participants are registered as [Callable]s with [method add_participant]. The prepare callable receives the transaction id and the participant's operation and must return [code]true[/code] to vote yes; the commit and abort callables receive the transaction id and must be idempotent, because [method recover] re-delivers logged decisions. When [member store_path] is set, every state change is written to a temporary file next to the store and renamed over it, so the log is never half written. [method recover] finishes in-doubt transactions after a restart: a logged decision is re-delivered, and no decision means abort. The same store also holds a persistent order book with price-time priority matching ([method place_order], [method match_orders]). All public methods lock an internal recursive mutex, so the coordinator may be shared between threads. Participant callables run while that lock is held and must not block on another thread that uses the coordinator. [codeblock] var coordinator := CgameTransactionCoordinator.new() coordinator.set_path("user://tx_log.json") coordinator.add_participant("a", Callable(ledger_a, "prepare"), Callable(ledger_a, "commit"), Callable(ledger_a, "abort")) coordinator.add_participant("b", Callable(ledger_b, "prepare"), Callable(ledger_b, "commit"), Callable(ledger_b, "abort")) var tx = coordinator.begin({"a": {"kind": "out", "ids": ["i0-1"]}, "b": {"kind": "in", "recs": [...]}}) print(coordinator.run(tx)) # "committed" or "aborted" [/codeblock]

method.name: add_participant
method.description: Registers a participant. [param prepare] is called as [code]prepare(tx_id, op)[/code] and returns a [bool] vote; [param commit] and [param abort] are called as [code]fn(tx_id)[/code].

method.name: clear_participants
method.description: Removes all participants. Use it to break reference cycles when the participant callables point back at their owner.

method.name: load_store
method.description: Loads the store from [member store_path]. Returns [code]false[/code] when the path is empty, the file is missing or it is corrupt; the coordinator then keeps its current (empty) state.

method.name: save_store
method.description: Writes the store to a temporary file and renames it over [member store_path]. Returns [code]true[/code] when nothing needs writing (in-memory mode) or the write succeeded.

method.name: begin
method.description: Logs a new transaction whose operations are keyed by participant name and returns its id ([code]"tx1"[/code], [code]"tx2"[/code], ...).

method.name: run
method.description: Drives the transaction to completion and returns [code]"committed"[/code], [code]"aborted"[/code] or [code]"crashed"[/code]. Running a finished transaction again is a no-op that returns its outcome; an unknown id is presumed aborted.

method.name: recover
method.description: Clears [member crashed] and [member crash_point] and finishes every unfinished transaction: a logged decision is re-delivered, a missing decision becomes an abort. Returns transaction id to outcome.

method.name: abort_stale
method.description: Aborts undecided transactions that started more than [param max_age_sec] seconds before [param now_unix] and returns how many were aborted.

method.name: place_order
method.description: Adds an order to the persistent book. [param side] is [code]"buy"[/code] or [code]"sell"[/code]. Returns the new order id.

method.name: cancel_order
method.description: Removes an order. Returns [code]false[/code] if it does not exist.

method.name: open_orders
method.description: Returns the open orders for [param item] and [param side], best price first and the older order first on equal prices.

method.name: match_orders
method.description: Matches crossing orders with price-time priority. Trades execute at the resting (older) order's price. Returns an array of dictionaries with [code]buyer[/code], [code]seller[/code], [code]item[/code], [code]price[/code], [code]qty[/code], [code]buy_id[/code] and [code]sell_id[/code].

members.member: Path of the durable store. An empty path keeps everything in memory.
A prepare call slower than this many milliseconds counts as a refusal. [code]0[/code] disables the timeout.
Test hook. [code]"before_decision"[/code] or [code]"after_decision"[/code] makes the next [method run] stop at that point and set [member crashed].
[code]true[/code] after a simulated crash. [method run] returns [code]"crashed"[/code] until [method recover] clears it.
Transaction records keyed by transaction id. Each record has [code]state[/code], [code]ops[/code], [code]decision[/code], [code]acked[/code] and [code]started[/code].
Open orders keyed by order id. Each order has [code]id[/code], [code]seq[/code], [code]owner[/code], [code]side[/code], [code]item[/code], [code]price[/code] and [code]qty[/code].
